method: UE5.8 current material name maps, 40-byte import maps, and 112-byte export maps resolve Texture2D outer-package imports. A complete Texture:ObjectProperty tag inside a MaterialExpressionTextureSample export must reference that import. The original material filename name must identify a unique PC material JSON whose TextureParameterValues explicitly reference the proposed PC full source package. Every current consumer must pass.
scope: Only the 100 actualhigher proposals from texture_upgrade_comparison.json. Offline project/exported JSON reads only.
limitations: binding_verified proves the stated dependency/same-name material/explicit PC parameter chain. It does not establish UV equivalence, exact graph-output wiring, visual fidelity, or completed UE replacement.
Current original material names are recovered from M_<name>_<8hex> filenames. The importer hash is retained as provenance, not inverted into a source path.
